### 3. Agent 任务 Navigation — TOOL_LIMITATION Reported

**Goal:** Click the "Agent 任务" (Agent Tasks) sidebar item, then locate "AG-1048 查看异常".

**Finding:** The sidebar menu items (OfferPilot平台, 工作空间, 运行概览, 知识与规则, Agent任务) are visually rendered as part of the canvas/artwork, NOT as interactive DOM elements. The only clickable element in the prototype viewer is `viewerContainer` — a generic catch-all for the Figma canvas image.

**Multiple attempts made:**
- Clicked `viewerContainer` at multiple different positions (sidebar Agent 任务 area, sidebar area, center of canvas, sidebar navigation area) — all returned "No visible change"
- Restart button (`ca8163f3-be8d-4f3a-bb64-9efc996cfe09`) clicked — no change
- Re-navigated to URL — same result

**Root cause:** This is a **static screenshot/design mock-up** within Figma, not an interactive prototype with hotspots/connectors. The sidebar items are painted as image pixels, not clickable regions. The Figma prototype viewer correctly exposes only `viewerContainer` — there are no hotspots defined on "Agent任务" or "AG-1048".

**Result: TOOL_LIMITATION** — Cannot click "Agent 任务" sidebar item because it is not an interactive hotspot in this Figma file; it is a static visual element. Cannot navigate to AG-1048 查看异常. No login barrier exists (this is an unauthenticated public prototype link).

This appears to be a single static frame.
